title: MVGlobalVisualStyle
description: Stage 2 art-direction lock from lyrics + song structure (Qwen3). Includes global_style_suffix, structural verse/chorus tension rules, and recurring core visual motifs.

parsed_lyrics_ref.description: Filename or relative path to lyrics-timing JSON (parse_lyrics.py output) used as the line-level lyrics source.

song_structure_ref.description: Filename or relative path to song-structure JSON, or composite like "lyrics-timing.json + song-sections-llm.json" when sections come from LLM segmentation.

global_style_suffix.description: English-only compact clause appended to every MV image prompt (style anchor).

global_style_suffix_zh.description: Optional Chinese gloss of global_style_suffix for humans.

structural_visual_rules.description: Per-section-role visual tension vs pacing; must distinguish verse vs chorus when those types exist in song-structure.

section_roles.description: Which musical section types this rule applies to (e.g. verse vs chorus).

visual_tension_en.description: English: how visual tension builds/releases vs other parts.

camera_framing_en.description: English: typical shot scale, composition bias, depth.

cut_motion_tempo_en.description: English: cut rhythm, camera move speed vs beats.

contrast_vs_other_sections_en.description: English: explicit contrast with verses or choruses (painting density, contrast, faces vs landscape).

shot_ratio.description: Optional: recommended shot-type ratio for this section role.

lens_emotion_en.description: English: what emotion does the lens choice convey for this section. e.g. 'shallow DOF creates dream-like isolation' or 'telephoto compression conveys unreachable distance'.

color_temperature.description: Color temperature feeling for this section role.

core_visual_motifs.description: Entities/environments/symbols that must recur for lyric coherence.

recurrence.description: When this motif should return across the timeline.

prompt_anchor_en.description: English phrase for prompts / continuity checks.

motif_notes_zh.description: Chinese: why this motif is non-optional for this song.

meaning_evolution.description: Optional: how this motif's meaning changes across song sections.

animation_art_style_en.description: English: illustrated / painterly / 3D / mixed-media look suitable for MV frames.

color_palette_en.description: English color-word anchors for grading (not hex codes required).

lighting_mood_en.description: English lighting vocabulary (time of day, contrast, key colors).

texture_material_en.description: English surface texture: film grain, brush strokes, paper, oil paint, etc.

motion_camera_en.description: English typical camera grammar and motion tempo for the MV.

negative_style_hints_en.description: English negative prompt fragments to avoid style drift.
